scenario: [LUNI.8.3] with [LGRA.9.8.11]: a `unit formula`'s function checks a bare argument as a bare number beside its dimensioned parameter, so `hz_to_period(440.0)` is refused. Pin: DS_VALIDATE_DIM_MISMATCH. PATH PINNED: the bare-argument arm of `dsc.typecheck.lgra_9_8_11_formula_call`.
rules_ds:
unit dimension frequency storage float64 base Hz
unit Hz: frequency

unit formula hz_period:
    hz_to_period(x: Hz): nanosecond  = 1e9 / x
    period_to_hz(x: nanosecond): Hz  = 1e9 / x

schema R scope logical:
    id: Int key

rule r:
    R s where s.id == 1 and hz_to_period(440.0) > 1_nanosecond
->
    log info "x"
